correctness.rationale: Superposition of n rate-λ Poisson processes is rate μ=nλ, whose independent exponential gaps have L/S labels by threshold r=τ/(2n). A point is isolated iff both adjacent gaps are long; occurrences of LL regenerate since conditional excess length of the outgoing long gap is independent of prior history. Two-state discounted recursion F_L=p+bF_S, F_S=aF_L+bF_S gives isolated-gap φ=a(1−b)/(1−b−ab); geometric compounding of independent isolated gaps under Bernoulli 1/n retention gives φ/[n−(n−1)φ]. Direct differentiation of the scale-free analytic fraction recovers mean e^t/λ and coefficient C=e^t(e^{t/2}−1−t)/λ². Strict convexity and initial negative derivative give one nonzero cancellation t*=2.51286241725234; no uniform-s claim. Independently used symbolic analytic series/moment identity differentiation and direct transform algebra; the general proof is the regenerative recursion, not a Monte Carlo sample.
